description: `plans/overview.html:1288-1396` rebuilds the kanban and command DOM, but all of the enrichers that make the page fully functional are one-shot IIFEs later in the file (`:1588-1674`, `:1692-1705`, `:1943-1955`, `:2196-2310`, `:2338-2353`). A console `renderTasks()` rerender preserves open `<details>` state, but it drops scope chips, workstream pills, copy-name buttons, kanban → command links, and leaves counts / Today-panel state stale. That makes the exposed rerender path unsafe for the manual refresh/debugging workflow the plan calls out.
